prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A group of nine young women stand in a dynamic, synchronized dance formation on a pastel pink stage. They are all dressed in coordinated outfits: white sleeveless crop tops and high-waisted, wide-leg blue jeans with a subtle repeating pattern. The central figure, slightly ahead of the others, wears a similar outfit but with a feathered trim on her shorts, making her stand out as the focal point. All the women have long, styled hair in various natural shades, and their expressions are bright, confident, and engaging, with subtle smiles as they look toward the camera.

The background is a seamless, clean white, creating a high-key, minimalist aesthetic that draws all attention to the performers. Behind them, the word "DECLINE" is repeatedly printed in bold red letters, adding a graphic, modern touch. The floor is covered with a large, soft pink mat featuring playful, oversized text and graphics in white and yellow, contributing to the youthful, energetic vibe.

The lighting is even and bright, eliminating harsh shadows and giving the scene a fresh, polished look. The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, capturing the symmetry and precision of the choreography. The overall style is crisp and contemporary, reminiscent of a high-production K-pop music video or a fashion editorial, with a focus on color harmony, group unity, and a vibrant, upbeat mood.
